title: Hanuman Chalisa, Part 1: See His Form

data.hook: You know these words. Now see them.

lines.text: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर। जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर॥
lines.tts: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर। जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर॥
lines.show: Jai Hanuman gyan gun sagar Jai Kapis tihun lok ujagar

lines.text: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and goodness. [1] Greatest of the vanar warriors, his light fills all three worlds. [2] Picture him shining over a sea of light.
lines.show: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and goodness. Greatest of the vanar warriors, his light fills all three worlds. Picture him shining over a sea of light.
lines.tts: Victory to Hanumaan, ocean of wisdom and goodness. Greatest of the Vaanar warriors, his light fills all three worlds. Picture him shining over a sea of light.

lines.text: राम दूत, अतुलित बल धामा। अंजनि पुत्र, पवनसुत नामा॥
lines.tts: राम दूत, अतुलित बल धामा। अंजनि पुत्र, पवनसुत नामा॥
lines.show: Ram doot atulit bal dhama Anjani-putra Pavan-sut nama

lines.text: Ram's messenger, with strength no one can match. [1] Son of Anjani, son of the Wind. [2] Picture him riding the wind.
lines.show: Ram's messenger, with strength no one can match. Son of Anjani, son of the Wind. Picture him riding the wind.
lines.tts: Raam's messenger, with strength no one can match. Son of Anjani, son of the Wind. Picture him riding the wind.

lines.text: महाबीर बिक्रम बजरंगी। कुमति निवार, सुमति के संगी॥
lines.tts: महाबीर बिक्रम बजरंगी। कुमति निवार, सुमति के संगी॥
lines.show: Mahabir bikram Bajrangi Kumati nivar sumati ke sangi

lines.text: The great hero, with a body strong as a thunderbolt. [1] He drives away bad thoughts, and stays with the good. [2] Picture him clearing the dark clouds from your mind.
lines.show: The great hero, with a body strong as a thunderbolt. He drives away bad thoughts, and stays with the good. Picture him clearing the dark clouds from your mind.

lines.text: कन्चन बरन बिराज सुबेसा। कानन कुन्डल कुन्चित केसा॥
lines.tts: कन्चन बरन बिराज सुबेसा। कानन कुन्डल कुन्चित केसा॥
lines.show: Kanchan baran biraj subesa Kanan kundal kunchit kesa

lines.text: Golden in colour, in fine clothes; [1] earrings in his ears, and curly hair. [2] Next time you chant or hear it, see this face.
lines.show: Golden in colour, in fine clothes; earrings in his ears, and curly hair. Next time you chant or hear it, see this face.
